question: Were exactly the failed proof obligations repaired, on exactly the families they failed on?

environment.preflight: PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_READY: 13/13 passed, 0 failed, 3 not applicable (corrected; see blockerCorrection)
environment.whyItMatters: the lane preflight gates on rendering and this container cannot bind sources. Every repair here is a non-rendering repair: no ink was added and every fixture PDF is byte-identical to the committed one, recomputed from disk and recorded on its row.

blocker.what: the pinned Master Library is not present and cannot be recovered in this container
blocker.detail: scripts/rcap-corpus/bootstrap-private-corpus.sh resolves the release asset Expungement_AI_RCAP_Master_Library_Edition_1.zip from Roger-LegalEase/legalease-source-artifacts@source-corpus-2026-08-28 and the request answers HTTP 403 to this session token. verify-packet-build-environment.mjs reports PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_READY with family_sources_bind failing, so neither --build nor --check starts for any family and no PDF can be re-rendered.
blocker.consequence: a repair that requires new ink is a rebuild, and no rebuild can run here.

environment.rasterState: BUILT_RASTER_PENDING. Nothing here is self-verified, none is RASTER_PASS, and visualDefects reads zero because nobody has looked.

blockerCorrection.supersedes: the corpus blocker recorded when these lanes were first returned

whatWasResolved.corpus: Recovered. The HTTP 403 was this session's own GitHub repository scope, not the token and not GitHub: the proxy answered "GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session. Use add_repo to request access." After add_repo for Roger-LegalEase/legalease-source-artifacts with access push, the release endpoint answers 200 and scripts/rcap-corpus/bootstrap-private-corpus.sh installs 51 jurisdictions / 499 files / 329 PDFs with the archive SHA-256 verified. Captain was right that it was never a permissions problem; the first FIX-A diagnosis and FIX-B's were wrong the same way.
whatWasResolved.preflight: PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_READY: 13/13 passed, 0 failed, 3 not applicable, after rebasing onto shift base c6d7ffe7cfdf45629f873e1a0e58ae4b174d45c6 and deepening the shallow clone with a bounded git fetch --depth=1000.
whatWasResolved.corpusEnvironment: MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR must be exported to the Master Library install root for a build to run; the hosts require it by name and throw without it. Exporting it does not trip master_library_not_at_operational_path, which still passes. The broadcast's warning is about OFFICIAL_FORMS_SOURCE_DIR, which stays unset.

blockerCorrection.theRealBlocker: both build hosts fail before they finish. Neither is in any FIX lane's owned paths, and every FIX entry point is a three-line importer of one of them.

westHost.diagnosis: westParticipantInstructions is defined at line 1524 and its writer was never defined and is never imported. Both call sites write participant-instructions.md, so every AZ and every CA family crashes there. buildAz crashes after production-field-map.json and the census are rewritten and before any fixture is rendered, which leaves a half-rebuilt overlay if it is not restored.
westHost.alsoNeeded: the CA path calls a pikepdf bridge and fails with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pikepdf' before it reaches writeText. python3 -m pip install pikepdf fixes that; the preflight does not check for it, so a CA lane learns after it has already cleared its output directory.

eastHost.failure: AssertionError: <documentId>/canonical: finalizer reported writes that have no artifact appearance
eastHost.diagnosis: the fields it names are exactly the ones the fact allowlist binds. The finalizer reports the write, and the flattened artifact appearance streams at every measured widget carry no drawn text for it, so exactValueObserved is false. In the completeness contract's vocabulary this is an invisible write, caught by the host's own build assertion.
reproducedOn: nj_indictable_conviction-set (NJ-CN-10557/canonical; arrestOff1, guiltyDt, guiltyCrt, DefAddr2, DefBirthDt, arrest1Dt among others)

blockerCorrection.whyThisExplainsTheStaleness: commit 9a484a6 (lane S1) extended both hosts' fact allowlists and added the west host's participant-instructions writer on 2026-08-31, and no family was rebuilt afterwards. These two defects are why: the west host crashes on the new writer and the east host's new writes produce no ink. Every overlay in the fleet has been stale since that commit, and no builder lane could have rebuilt one.
blockerCorrection.consequenceForTheseRows: the rows below stay STOPPED and their reason is unchanged in substance -- a repair that needs new ink is a rebuild, and no rebuild completes. What changed is why: not a missing corpus, but two defects in hosts this lane does not own and must not edit while other lanes build from them.
blockerCorrection.whatFixANeeds: a lane that owns the two hosts. The west host needs its missing writeText helper and pikepdf in the build environment; the east host needs the finalizer to actually draw the newly allowlisted fields, or those bindings withdrawn until it can. Once either host builds, FIX-A's stopped rows are ordinary rebuilds.

rootCause.finding: the S1 fact allowlist and the shared semantic finalizer disagree, on every field S1 added, and the finalizer refuses all of them.
rootCause.evidence: reports/actual-writes.json in the committed nj_indictable_conviction-set build records 173 fields refused with reason classified_unwritable_by_role, category role. Every one of the twelve terminal names SHARED_EXACT_FACT_ALLOWLIST and the family allow bind is in that refused list: DefName, DefAddrStr, DefAddr2, DefAddr3, ExpungeCntyName, DefBirthDt, origCaseNums, arrestOff1, arrest1Dt, arrest1CaseNum, guiltyDt and guiltyCrt. Not one of them appears in the written list.
rootCause.mechanism: the host's own decisionBasis says it: "shared exact terminal-name fact allowlist; shared semantic finalizer still controls". The allowlist promotes the field to candidate_write, the finalizer refuses it by role, and the build then asserts because the map claimed a write that produced no appearance. That is why the rebuild fails and why no overlay has been rebuilt since commit 9a484a6.
rootCause.whyItMattersForTheseRows: if the finalizer is right that these fields are not writable by role, then the treatment this lane applied to them -- declare the blank required before filing and name it for the participant -- is the correct final answer and not a placeholder, and the repair is to withdraw the allowlist entries rather than to make the finalizer draw them. If the allowlist is right, the finalizer's role classification is what needs to change. Which way it resolves is a legal and product question about whether, for example, the defendant's own name on the New Jersey petition is the platform's to write, and a repair lane does not decide it.
rootCause.whatWouldSettleIt: one owner of the shared finalizer and the two hosts reconciling the role classification against the allowlist, field by field, and stating which side governs. Until then no east or west family can be rebuilt, and the stopped rows in these four returns stay stopped.
rootCause.notDecidedHere: this lane changed neither host, neither allowlist, nor the finalizer. Other lanes in this shift build from the same files.

fleetObservation.finding: both hosts are ahead of their overlays, and the New York family is the third instance of the same shared-host defect FIX01 returned.
evidence: the CA overlay's explicitMappingsByVariant carries six CR-180 mappings; CA_PRIMARY_WRITES in the current west host carries eight, adding CrtCounty to matter.county and ConvictionDate to matter.conviction_date. Those two are a rebuild.
the CA overlay carries no blankTreatment key at all, which the current host emits on every REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING refusal.
the NY overlay carries not_supported_by_exact_participant_fact_map on 86 rows, which the current east host never emits.
fleetObservation.whatThisLaneCouldNotDo: the east host scripts/build-census-v1-nj_arrest_no_conviction-set.mjs and the west host scripts/build-census-v1-az_marijuana_expungement_arrest_no_charges-set.mjs are shared by every NJ, NY, RI, PA, AZ and CA family and are owned by no FIX lane in this shift. Every FIX03 and FIX01 entry point is a three-line importer. Neither host states requiredBeforeFiling on the channel the completeness contract reads, so every family they build will fail the same way again after the next rebuild. This needs a lane that owns the hosts.

rows.verdict: BUILT_RASTER_PENDING for the repaired obligations; two obligations returned unrepaired

obligationsRepaired.repair: three whole components carried one blanket sentence each and the contract could not read any of them. CR-181 is the court's order front to back and now carries the typed class court_prosecutor_clerk_or_agency_owned on all fifty-four failing rows. CR-106 (proof of service) and MC-031 (attached declaration) are the participant's own forms and were split by what each blank is: a mark is an election, a signature stays a signature, and every other blank is a fact the participant supplies, with the proof of service told to wait until service has actually occurred.

thirty-one rows carried the reason "No allowlisted, source-supported fact is offered to this terminal field", which the current host no longer emits; caRefusalReason returns REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING for them. They are declared on the contract's channel and disclosed by field name and page in a rewritten participant-instructions.md.

five /Btn controls carried "not established by this evidence variant", which the contract reads as an incomplete fixture rather than a reason to ship an election blank. They are the petitioner's own marks and now carry participant_sworn_narrative_or_legal_election with isSelectionControl.

all four components are rendered; the record named only the file each was rendered into, so no documentId appeared anywhere in it. reports/rendered-artifacts.json now carries a components array naming each documentId, its form number and role, and the fixture files it was rendered into.

obligationsStopped.whatIsMissing: these are the Penal Code section 17(b) reduction elections. The host maps these exact terminal names as route.pc17b.* controls on the ca-17b-reduction route and on no other, so on a 1203.42 packet they belong to a branch of the form this route does not use. The contract's word for that is NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE, and classifyBlank cannot reach it for a ROUTE_DETERMINED field class: a route election either gets marked or stays a defect. Marking it is a re-render. The rows now state routeDetermined and say which route owns them, rather than asking the participant to decide a reduction this packet does not seek.

obligationsStopped.whatIsMissing: CR-180's terminal names all end in [0], so rowKeyOf collapses the whole form into one pseudo-row, and that row counts as incomplete while any REQUIRED_KNOWN cell in it is unwritten. The unwritten cells are the petitioner's street address, telephone, email and mailing address and the court's address and county. CA_PRIMARY_WRITES binds the county (CrtCounty) and a rebuild would write it; it binds none of the contact cells, so zeroing this counter needs both a host mapping and a re-render. This is the CR-180 defect the completeness contract was written about, and it is not a classification this lane can make.

obligationsRepaired.repair: the same stale untrusted refusal class not_supported_by_exact_participant_fact_map as the New Jersey and Rhode Island families on the same shared host, which the current host no longer emits. Sixty-two rows are the host's required_before_filing determination on the contract's channel, all disclosed by field name and page; fifteen checkbox and radio terminals are elections, which is what the contract says a checkbox is; two are viewer buttons; one is a sworn election whose caption tripped the offence-row pattern and now declares isSelectionControl.

the affidavit-of-service block, which the host puts in one class the contract does not know and the contract splits in two. The three notary date parts are completed by the notary at the moment of the notarial act and now carry signature_or_date_participant_completion; the three service facts are the participant's, once service has actually happened, and are declared required-before-filing and disclosed with that condition stated.

NY-CPL-160.59-SEAL-VERIFICATION is recorded in the field map as POST_ORDER_SOURCE_ONLY with generatedParticipantArtifact false. It is not a missing companion form; it is a document the packet deliberately does not generate. reports/rendered-artifacts.json now carries a componentsNotGenerated array saying so.

obligationsStopped.whatIsMissing: a re-measurement. The census measured the caption "Charges" for the terminal named Other on the certificate-of-disposition request, and the packet writes a different terminal whose caption is also "Charges". The contract reads a blank whose printed label is written elsewhere in the same document as a fact the packet demonstrably holds, and on this caption it is right to. Correcting the caption means re-reading the source PDF.
